sources.fresh-1: io.stdout:setvbuf('no');local m=assert(package.loadlib('./native.dll','luaopen_native'))('probe');local kind="fresh";local visit=1;local original=getfenv(coroutine.yield);debug.setfenv(coroutine.yield,{marker=37});local co=coroutine.create(function()if kind=='failed'then error('old')end;if kind=='yielded'then coroutine.yield()end end);if kind~='fresh'then coroutine.resume(co)end;local globals={marker=31};debug.setfenv(co,globals);local env={};local s,b,a,old,new,n,result=m.load_thread(co,'return marker',function(i)if i==visit then coroutine.yield(29)end end,'=reader-environment',3,env);debug.setfenv(coroutine.yield,original);print(s,b,a,old,new,n,type(result),#env);for i,e in ipairs(env)do print('env',i,e.marker)end;if type(result)=='function'then print('compiled',getfenv(result)==globals,result())end;collectgarbage();print('usable',46)
